sources.title: PaliGemma | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: PaliGemma 2 is available in 3B, 10B, and 28B parameter sizes, which are based on Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B models, respectively. The original PaliGemma models are available in the 3B size. For more information on Gemma model variants, see the Gemma models list.

sources.snippet: PaliGemma is a set of multi-modal large language models published by Google based on the Gemma model. Both a pre-trained and instruction tuned models are available.

sources.snippet: Overview paligemma-3b-pt-224 is a vision-language model by Google that processes images and text prompts together to perform multimodal understanding tasks. Maintained by lucataco on Replicate, this model contains 3 billion parameters and accepts 224×224 pixel images with 128-token input and output text sequences.
